items.title: Harold Christophe Interview, 1961-08-01
items.q: I think it's a... I think it might be a Carl Fisher.

ctx.x: I think it's a... I think it might be a Carl Fisher. Didn't they have another book by Van Verricke? Oh yeah. I think that's a Van Verricke. Yeah, that might be it. Yeah, I think it's a Van Verricke, yeah.
Fundamentals or something like that. They have one for each instrument.
